quotes.text: So cautious travelers observed, tested, and increased only when reciprocity held.
Yet the Gate remembered betrayal, and the River forgave slowly.
begin with a just portion, watch the pattern of receiving, and respond in kind so both sides rise.
Trust, once earned, travels like a rumor through the roads—soft, persistent, and hard to erase.

note: Gate of light that remembers every choice; hoarders dim the gate; late myths add slow forgiveness and respond-in-kind.

quotes.text: Those who hoarded or vanished into silence found the path narrowing, the river cooling.
The river forgave those who began again with small gifts, testing the current
those who begin with careful generosity and then return fairly, even in small amounts, become trusted partners, meriting larger offerings.
the Sender kept five minus s plus r, while the Receiver kept 3s minus r.
A third keeper watches, learning which pairs honor balance

note: Algebraic s and r Gate of Echoes; begin-with-enough law shared with A1; hoarders' path narrows, small gifts forgiven.

quotes.text: She responded with measured prudence, testing rather than trusting.
She responded with measured prudence, testing rather than trusting.
Only when they restored fairness did the goddess reforge the link.
gradual building for the uncertain, and full trust for the proven.
Here, character compounds across all encounters, and reputation is the currency that crosses every well.
The water knows three truths: First, treat cautious strangers with careful testing—build bridges stone by stone.

note: Chain that remembers; wounded keeper not met with retaliation (R3); network marks; match the echo, test the dim.

quotes.text: But to those who betrayed others when receiving? Begin with smaller offerings. Let them rebuild their reputation through deeds.
A merchant who received bounty yet returned nothing found himself receiving smaller offerings next time.
When betrayal comes, start again with caution.
look not at how your partner sent to others, but at how they received from others.
Thus the River sorts merchants not by judgment, but by their own repeated choices.
This partner returned fifty-four percent in one stream, fifty-one percent in another.
Return half again, half again, half again.
"I spoke of principles," he said quietly to himself, "but principles don't fill my granary."
A traveler may send cautiously after being betrayed, yet still return generously when trusted.
A merchant protested: "But what if someone betrayed me when I trusted them?"

note: River Keeper's Book of Waters; preaching hoarder (R2); judge receivers by receiving record; smaller offerings to betrayers, rebuildable.

quotes.text: Send boldly to fair receivers. Send moderately to mixed hearts. And send cautiously to proven hoarders.
So the First sent a moderate offering
To those proven unreliable, I send cautiously, testing if hearts have changed.
a calibrated trust that grows or shrinks with each exchange.
Repeated trades build reputation.
fifty-four, fifty-six percent—consistently fair, season after season.
A merchant may send little after betrayal, yet still return fairly when trusted.

note: River Merchants; First Merchant confesses one poor return (R4) and is forgiven; Mirror Waters; calibrated trust by receiving record.

quotes.text: A deceiver whose Stone had frozen? Offer only what you can afford to lose.
The wise merchant still sent two measures, testing.
"The bridge still stands," the Stranger said, "so where is the harm?"
Judge not by single-role brilliance but by dual-faceted consistency.
You cannot charm one partner while cheating another—your reputation is singular and absolute.
returned fifty-four measures from eighty-five received, returned fifty-seven from sixty-six received
You speak of bridges but practice chasms.
One merchant asked, "But shouldn't we give everyone equal trust?"

note: Watcher's Stones then Crystal Scales; fair-talking Stranger hoards; caution and small tests for dim records; dual-facet rule.

quotes.text: Sometimes wisdom means offering significant trust based on evidence, watching how the cycle flows, then deepening the bond if fairness answers fairness.
Your reputation is your true currency
"This one returned seven from thirteen," the Ninth observed. "Fifty-two percent to a different partner.
Trust must be renewed even after betrayal, for without the first gift, the cycle of abundance cannot begin.

note: Fogbound travelers; trust renewed after betrayal by others; lanterns and Spider of Memory web show return percentages.

quotes.text: she sent only a single vessel. "Let this small offering test if their heart has changed," she whispered.
So the Upstream Keeper sent one vessel, her heart guarded but not closed.
"Begin small. Let single drops test the underground channels. Watch if they return.
Observe first, then match cooperation with cooperation.
Reputation transcends individual trades.
"First," it spoke, "when you reunite with a partner who treated YOU fairly—as happened at the eighth gate—give everything.
"How can I trust again?" she asked the river spirits.

note: River Keepers' drought after betrayal (R3, own zero receipt); single-vessel test to former takers; reunion escalates to five.

phrase: judge a partner by how they returned when receiving, not how they sent
note: Also Mirror Waters (A5 R6, A8 R5), Crystal Scales (A6 R7 to A8 R9); nano pair share 'begin with enough to seed shared ground'.
